record.name: Outlaw Tech
record.description: Outlaw Techs are masters of illegal modifications and black market technology, using their skills to create powerful but unauthorized enhancements and bypass security systems.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Master of illicit tech, weaving together scraps and gadgets to outwit foes.
visual_signals: Cybernetic implants visible under the skin
Tattered black jacket with hidden pockets

progression_tree.description: Gain proficiency in two types of thieves' tools or one type of artisan's tools.

effects.value: Two types of thieves' tools, one type of artisan's tools

progression_tree.description: When attempting to repair or modify a device with your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1), the DC is reduced by 2.
You can use your proficiency bonus to add your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to a Charisma (Deception) check to bypass security systems.

effects.value: Add Int mod to Deception checks for bypassing security

progression_tree.description: You can use your proficiency bonus and Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to create a custom gadget with a specific function, which lasts for one hour.

effects.value: Custom gadget creation with specified function

progression_tree.description: You can use your proficiency bonus and Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) to create a device that enhances one of your existing skills, making it more effective.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a balanced stance with feet shoulder-width apart, hands hovering over blasters at the ready.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Pulsates with an otherworldly blue aura, indicative of illicit tech experimentation.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Generate a concept art for an engineer specializing in scavenging and repurposing Star Wars technology.
contextual_modifiers: Show the engineer's workshop in the background
Highlight the use of scavenged parts in their equipment
